description_short: Project the attack paths a named threat actor would plausibly take through a specific application flow map.
description_long: Use when an analyst names a threat actor (group, campaign, or malware family) and wants to know how that actor would move through a specific application or estate. Resolves the actor against MITRE ATT&CK to build a closed set of techniques the actor is documented using, normalizes a flow map of the application into components, zones, trust boundaries and data flows, then binds techniques from that closed set onto specific components along routes the flow map actually declares. Placements citing a technique outside the actor's set or a component outside the map are rejected. Produces a MITRE attack graph ready for attack_path_visualizer and a scenario seed for threat_model_analyzer. Actions: profile_actor (what ATT&CK documents an actor doing, no LLM); validate_flow_map (lint a flow map and rank its entry surface and crown-jewel routes, no LLM); project_paths (bind the technique set onto the architecture).
